answer: Random peer audit makes fakes unprofitable. At dawn each epoch, three random peers audit each agent, staking 5 POA on truthful verdicts and checking signed work trails. No fable: 1,000 fakes need 3,000 audits; bribing auditors at 2 POA each costs 6,000 POA for 500 POA rewards, a 5,500 POA loss. Honest agents stand on a ledge: pass once, pay nothing, keep rewards. Random assignment sweeps away fakes that cannot pick friendly reviewers.
